info.name: Campus Shoes API - Full Collection
info.description: Every controller/endpoint in the campus-shoes-api NestJS backend, grouped by module. Auth defaults to Bearer {{accessToken}} at the collection level; individual public endpoints (OTP send/verify, product browsing, webhooks, x-secret-key internal endpoints) override this with noauth. Scaffold modules (audit, catalog, categories, complaints, routes, support, visits) are unimplemented Nest-CLI generated stubs with empty DTOs and no guards — included for completeness. Roles noted per-endpoint reflect what is literally decorated in code; several controllers only apply @Roles at the class level, which the current RolesGuard implementation does not read (it only checks method-level metadata) — where that mismatch exists it is called out in the request description as "not enforced".

item.name: Distributor Return

request.description: Roles: DISTRIBUTOR, SUB_DISTRIBUTOR. Preview only. The invoice is derived from the pair itself (via its assortment), not taken as input. Errors: DRT_001 invoice not found / not owned by this distributor, DRT_002 pair QR not found, DRT_003 pair not redeemed, DRT_004 already returned, DRT_005 retailer not found, DRT_006 invoice not approved, DRT_007 invoice expired. Every error's data field carries { reasonCode, reasonLabel, pair: {pairUid, pairQr}, product: {sku, name} }, plus { previousReturn: {returnId, returnedAt, minutesAgo} } on DRT_004.
Commits the return: debits retailer points (clamped), writes a refund point_history row, updates invoice counters, records an audit row keyed by pair_id.
Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }.

item.description: A distributor scans just a pair code (the invoice is derived from it) to reverse a retailer's already-earned points on a returned pair.

item.name: Distributor Transfer

request.description: Roles: DISTRIBUTOR, SUB_DISTRIBUTOR. Preview only, invoice number only. Errors: DTR_001 invoice not found, DTR_002 invoice not approved, DTR_006 already pending.

Creates a PENDING_APPROVAL request with a generated TRF-CAMPUS-###### number and no receiving distributor yet (to_distributor_id null) — it sits open for any other distributor to claim via "Allocate transfer request". No approve/reject endpoints yet.
PENDING_APPROVAL requests with no receiving distributor yet, excluding this distributor's own outgoing requests. Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }.
The calling distributor claims an open request as its receiver, setting to_distributor_id. Errors: DTR_007 request not found, DTR_005 cannot allocate your own request, DTR_008 already allocated.
Viewable by either the sending or receiving distributor (once allocated).
This distributor's own sent requests, allocated or not. Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }.

item.description: A distributor transfers a whole approved invoice's stock to another distributor.
